title: StateWise: Teaching Language Models to Track and Obey Evolving Constraints in Multi-Turn Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2610.33766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Users of conversational assistants rarely state all requirements up front: they add constraints, amend them, withdraw them, digress, and return. Instruction-tuned LLMs fail here in two ways: active constraints stop being honored as turns accumulate (persistence failure), and withdrawn constraints keep being enacted (relapse). The only existing repair we know of is an external ledger that re-injects a compiled specification every turn. We propose StateWise, a self-improving approach that teaches a single LLM to maintain its own revisable constraint state, a typed state with tombstones for revoked constraints, so persistence and relapse are measured by executable checkers and ground-truth states are compiled for free. translated_title: StateWise：教语言模型在多轮对话中追踪并遵守不断演变的约束
translated_abstract: 对话助手的用户很少在一开始就说明全部需求：他们会添加约束、修改约束、撤销约束、离题后再回归主题。经过指令微调的大语言模型在这种场景下会以两种方式失败：随着对话轮次的累积，仍然有效的约束不再被遵守（持续性失败），以及已被撤销的约束仍被继续执行（复发）。据我们所知，现有的唯一修复方法是一个外部账本，它在每一轮都重新注入一份编译好的规范。我们提出了StateWise，这是一种自我改进的方法，它教会单个大语言模型维护自己的可修订约束状态——一种为已撤销约束设置墓碑标记的类型化状态——从而可以通过可执行的检查器来度量持续性与复发问题，并且可以免费编译出真实值状态。StateWise在两项互补技能上对大语言模型进行微调：将对话总结为其约束状态，以及基于该状态进行条件化响应，然后模型在自己的轨迹上进行自我训练，只保留通过……的轮次（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出StateWise自我改进方法，通过教大语言模型维护带有墓碑标记的可修订约束状态，并在“状态总结”和“基于状态响应”两项技能上微调与自我训练，解决了多轮对话中有效约束不被遵守和已撤销约束复发两大难题。
en_tdlr: StateWise is a self-improving approach that teaches an LLM to maintain its own revisable constraint state with tombstones for revoked constraints, fine-tuned on summarizing dialogue into state and responding conditioned on that state, addressing persistence failures and relapse in multi-turn dialogue.
